# Lawrence Velasco

> Software solutions developer and AI specialist building practical mobile, web, backend, and AI-assisted products.

Lawrence's work covers software solutions and product delivery, mobile apps for iOS and Android, web and backend systems, AI-assisted development, connected devices, and project leadership through release.

## Pages

- [Official portfolio](https://lawrencevelasco.com/): Overview of Lawrence's software, AI, mobile, web, and delivery work.
- [AI-enabled software delivery](https://lawrencevelasco.com/ai-enabled-software-delivery/): Approach to bounded tasks, durable context, automated checks, and human review.
- [San Bidet](https://lawrencevelasco.com/projects/san-bidet/): Independently shipped restroom and bidet finder for the Philippines.
- [AniVoice](https://lawrencevelasco.com/projects/anivoice/): Independently shipped app for discovering anime characters and voice actors.
- [Pitchie](https://lawrencevelasco.com/projects/pitchie/): Independently shipped pitch-recognition training game.
